subject: Decision: benchmark verdict and wind-down
body:
Team,

Closing this one out with a clear-eyed decision.

The paper-scale sweep confirmed Ondrej's read: on index-partition scheduling, bang-bang protocol search edged annealing by 2% on solution quality but at 6x the compute; on cache-eviction it lost outright, plateauing where annealing kept improving. Verdict: simulated annealing remains our default for both internal workloads.

Decisions:
1. No productization. The workstream wraps at window close on 7/13.
2. The distributed search harness (91% scaling efficiency is nothing to sneeze at) gets donated to the shared tooling repo - Wei owns the handoff.
3. Ondrej writes the internal tech report; Eleni has asked that negative results get the same polish as wins, and I agree.

This is what a good kill looks like. Thank you all.

Anders
